title: Minimum path sum
statement: Find the right/down path from the top-left to the bottom-right with the smallest sum of cell values (non-negative).
hints: The best way into a cell comes from the better of above and left.

solution.explanation: dp[i][j] = g[i][j] + min(dp[i−1][j], dp[i][j−1]). Because moves only go right and down, the grid is a DAG and row-major order is a topological order. If moves could go in all four directions, this would be Dijkstra (Part 4), not DP.
